topic: Read paths pass no spaces yet; what SP-025 must cover in the rag layer
detail: SP-024 gives Search SearchOpts.Spaces, but orchd passes none, so every search still reads every collection (the base and each space's, Quarantine included), as before; Document, Copy, HasSource, ListSources and SourcesWrittenBy read every collection too. SP-025 must give each read path the caller's readable spaces. Notes for it: (1) 'shared' reads the base without the space filter, and the base still holds chunks SP-023 stored with other spaces and quarantine in their payload until SP-027 moves them, so a policy reader must never be given 'shared' (or the base must be filtered); (2) internal/daemon/handoff.go canonicalStored matches synced copies in any space and DeleteSource removes the path URI from every space: scope both to the writer's space; (3) Qdrant errors returned to clients carry collection names, which contain space names: return generic errors and keep detail in orchd's log; (4) the Ingest RPC ignores a Copy error (fail-open) for its sync-writer refusal, so a client in the same space can replace a synced doc when the store cannot be read (pre-existing; cross-space moves are refused in rag).
